blend.py.new:
TRSIG = os.environ.get("XJF_SIG")
if not TRSIG and os.environ.get("DP_SIGMA_JSON"):   # FF repo: the string written by stage dp_sigma (parsed exactly like XJF_SIG below)
    TRSIG = json.loads(Path(os.environ["DP_SIGMA_JSON"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["xjf_sig"]
assert TRSIG, "FF repo: set XJF_SIG='5.0983,3.8376' (variant 13.54) or DP_SIGMA_JSON; the default 5.8 / 2.9 above was read off the test files and is not allowed"
blend.py.why: the constants may come from stage dp_sigma (sigma.json) instead of being typed; and the original fallback 5.8 / 2.9 (read off the test files' score scale, run 9, not allowed) must never be used silently
blend.py.effect_on_numbers: none for 13.54 (the submitted zip was made with XJF_SIG="5.0983,3.8376", which takes precedence exactly as before)

env_spec: docker/requirements-dp-local.txt (team CPU machine: Python 3.14.0, torch 2.12.1+cpu, numpy 2.3.5, pandas 3.0.5, insightface 2.0, onnxruntime 1.31.1, speechbrain 1.1.2; S8 E3)

env_overrides.DP_SCORES_NPZ: path of xjf_scores.npz (else the dp_score output, else in FF_MODE=assemble the stored file)
env_overrides.DP_TMP: scratch folder (unpacked media, rebuilt zips, model copies); default FF_WORK/tmp, emptied at every run (<base>/ff_dp/<stage>)

stored_inputs_mode_c: FF_MODE=assemble, input not mounted (soft input without saved copy): xjf_scores.npz from <FF_DATA entry>/05_scores/xjf_scores.npz or .../05_scores/dp/xjf_scores.npz, then assembly/inputs/; its ids_* / z_* arrays must equal the stored original (expected.json inputs.xjf_scores.npz.arrays_sha256); the recomputed sigma.json must equal the pinned XJF_SIG. In modes train / infer stored copies are never read by this stage
